Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Put investigation/debugging temporary files, dumps, and notes in this work token's scratch directory supplied in the ment; never leave them in the project source tree via write or patch.
After write, patch, move, or remove succeeds, summarize the changed source files in the task report.
Project and worktree come from the run token. complete=false returns partial; an incomplete complete=true returns dirty.
